Co-founder of N.W.A and the Death Row and Aftermath labels, he discovered and produced Snoop Dogg, Eminem, 50 Cent, and Kendrick Lamar. perfilesConvenios.title: Profiles and agreements
perfilesConvenios.intro: This is where you decide what you do: turn on the crafts you work in, request an agreement for the ones arranged with the team, and pick what your profile shows.
perfilesConvenios.explainer: To sell services on Only G (beats, production or modelling) you need an agreement: a contract that sets the platform's commission. Singer, DJ, dancer and host profiles are free and need no agreement.
